youtube_description:
Here's a mistake I see with beginners: holding their breath during stomach vacuums.

A lot of beginners inhale, hold their breath, and by the end of the 20 seconds they're struggling unnecessarily. You actually want to be able to breathe as you're doing these vacuums. Take short breaths through your nose while you hold it.

Your breathing will be restricted during the set, so don't try to take deep breaths during the contraction. When you're resting between sets, take deep belly breaths and recover before you start again.
